mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 8.0% signals labor market tightening, increasing corporate hiring and earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 8.0%, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate manufacturing slowdown and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO and HOUST both decline, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in residential mortgage credit below 390,000 million dollars signals reduced housing demand and market stabilization, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, when RSAFS falls below 390,000, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate rise above 0.1% signals monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.1%, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls above 131,000 thousand persons indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 131,000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts increase above 650.0 thousand units signals strong residential demand, boosting construction activity and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST exceeds 650.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for the signal is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle recoveries, a decline in industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: In early-cycle recoveries, when INDPRO falls below 95.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.
